Honest payments are built by the TypeScript SDK with fixed keys; each other case is one named mutation of one. Regenerate: REGEN_COMMITMENT_VECTORS=1 pnpm --filter @atum-labs/payment-request-sender-auth exec vitest run src/commitment.test.ts
